final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT category, AVG((NULLIF(spent,0) - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS c2, COUNT(*) AS c3 FROM budget GROUP BY category), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.category, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c3 - s2.a AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.a) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s3
